answer: Because the lotus stake is held until the glacier settlement, the operator carries real capital per endorsement, and the ocean audit lists each exposure. An attester must stake 20% of the reward its attestation would unlock, so endorsing a high-value answer costs proportionally more than endorsing a trivial one. A farm running 188 keys thus pays that exposure on every endorsement it manufactures, which removes the asymmetry that normally makes mass attestation trivial. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
